column1: CoveragePASSAll four final CRDs are covered by at least one ORR; D_O = D_C for the identified distinction set.
Duplicate obligationsPASSH2-ORR1--H2-ORR4 impose distinct preservation obligations.
CompatibilityPASSNo pair of ORRs imposes mutually incompatible preservation obligations.
TraceabilityPASSEach ORR traces to at least one final CRD and visible source artefact.
Orphan ORRsPASSNo ORR lacks an originating CRD.
Uncovered CRDsPASSNo identified final CRD lacks a corresponding ORR.
Assessability H2-ORR1PASSThe candidate representation can be assessed for preservation of Required versus NotRequired.

Assessability H2-ORR2PASSThe candidate representation can be assessed for preservation of SafeFeasible versus NotSafeFeasible; the method does not prescribe the computation used to establish the class.
Assessability H2-ORR3PASSThe documented criterion distinguishes lane-change initiation at or below versus above 100 ms; source marks the bound tbc and dangerous-zone condition tbd.
Assessability H2-ORR4PASSThe documented criterion distinguishes steering-command provision at or below versus above 50 ms; source marks the bound tbc.
